Last week, a helpful note for pet owners
It concerns the desk

Notice for Travelers

Travelers with companion animals should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways before they head to the gate. The desk gives calm, plain guidance so pet plans stay organized and pets are handled with care. Staff members review travel papers, carrier needs, and cabin or hold arrangements with steady attention.

Please bring clear records for your animal and keep the carrier easy to inspect. <<FACT F082>> If a trip involves a rabbit, the team will confirm the remaining paperwork details and help you prepare the right documents without extra stress. The senior coordinator makes daily service calls, and the trained staff give patient support to each animal.

For quick help, updates, or a final check before departure, stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
